about:
Colombo Wardrobe is the online shop of Spencer Denim Industries Pvt Ltd, a Sri Lankan fashion retailer for women, men and kids. We sell clothing, footwear and accessories, and we deliver across Sri Lanka and to customers overseas.

What you will find here

The shop is organised into Women, Men and Kids, with New Arrivals and Sale pages to show you what has just come in and what is reduced. Each product page shows photographs, the colours and sizes with any that are sold out marked and, where we have written one, a size guide. Where customers have reviewed a product you can read what they said, and a Verified buyer mark means the review comes from someone whose order we delivered.

Shopping with us

  • Save your favourites to a wishlist without signing in. The list is kept in your own browser.
  • Check out as a guest, or create an account to keep your addresses and follow your orders.
  • Pay online at checkout, where the payment methods open to you are shown.
  • Follow your parcel: once your order has been sent, the courier's name and tracking number appear on your order page.

Delivery and returns

We deliver to every district in Sri Lanka and ship overseas with a tracked international service. If something is not right, you can return or exchange most items. The details are on our delivery and returns pages, linked at the foot of every page.

Get in touch

Questions about an order, a size or anything else? Write to us through the Contact page and we aim to reply.
privacy:
Colombo Wardrobe is the online shop of Spencer Denim Industries Pvt Ltd (we and us). This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, who receives it, how long we keep it and what choices you have. We aim to handle your personal data in line with Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022, and we apply the same practices to every customer, whether you live in Sri Lanka or overseas.

When you order or pay

  • Your order. Your name, email address, telephone number and delivery address (for an overseas order also your country and, where your country uses one, your postcode), the items you bought, the delivery method and whether the order is paid. We use this to take payment, deliver your order, send you updates and deal with returns and questions.
  • Extra details kept with an order. Any note you add, the IP address the order was placed from and, if you upload a bank transfer payment slip, that slip.
  • Payment notifications. When you pay with PayPal, PayPal sends us notifications about the payment. We keep each one as PayPal sent it, and it can include your name and email address.

If you have an account

  • An account is optional. It holds your name, email address and password (stored in scrambled form, a hash, never as readable text), the addresses you save, your order history and, if you add them, your phone number and default delivery district. We use it to let you sign in, check out faster and follow your orders.
  • If an account is locked after repeated failed sign-ins, we record that with the IP address and browser details.

When you write to us or join the newsletter

  • Newsletter. Your email address, the time you signed up and the IP address you signed up from. We keep the time and the IP address as proof that you agreed.
  • Questions you send us. The name, email address, optional telephone number, subject, message and order number that you give us, and the IP address it was sent from, so that we can answer you.
  • Reviews. A review is shown with your first name and the first letter of your last name (for example Nimal P.), and with a Verified buyer mark when we have delivered an order to you. We never show your email address.

When you browse

We count page views to see what is popular. A record holds the page address (with anything private removed), the time, the kind of device, how you arrived and a random visit number, which is replaced after 30 minutes without activity. It holds no IP address, name or email address, so we cannot follow you from one visit to the next.

To slow down repeated requests, the server also uses the IP address a request comes from when you sign in, sign up, order, upload a payment slip, write to us or join the newsletter.

Cookies and your browser

We use a few cookies, all set by us and none for advertising, and we load no third-party analytics or tracking scripts on our pages.

  • sd_cart keeps your shopping bag if you are not signed in. It holds a random code and lasts 30 days from your last visit.
  • sd_customer_auth keeps you signed in if you have an account, for up to 30 days.
  • sd_vs holds the random visit number described above and expires after 30 minutes without activity.

Your wishlist, recently viewed products, recent searches and chosen delivery country and district are saved in your own browser, and you can clear them in your browser settings. A map on our Contact page, if shown, comes from Google Maps or OpenStreetMap, which may receive your IP address. PayPal sets its own cookies on its own pages.

Who receives your data

  • PayPal. When you pay with PayPal we send it your order total, the recipient's name and delivery address, a reference to your order and our shop name, so that it can process the payment. We never see or store your card details. PayPal's own privacy policy applies to what it holds, and it may process data outside Sri Lanka.
  • Couriers. We give the courier that delivers your parcel your name, delivery address and telephone number.
  • Our email service. It sends the order and account emails we address to you.
  • Our staff. They use separate sign-ins and see your data only to do their work.

We do not sell your personal data. We may disclose it where the law requires us to.

How long we keep your data

  • Visit records are removed automatically after a set period (90 days as standard).
  • Order and invoice records are kept for as long as we need them for accounting, tax and legal reasons.

For everything else we keep personal data only as long as the purpose it was collected for needs, and we deal with each request to delete or anonymise it individually. Backups are kept for a limited time, and data deleted from the shop can remain in them until they expire.

Keeping your data safe

Our website uses an encrypted (HTTPS) connection. No system is completely secure, so if a breach affects you we will tell you, and the authorities, as the law requires.

Your rights

Under the Personal Data Protection Act you may:

  • ask what personal data we hold about you and receive a copy;
  • ask us to correct data that is wrong;
  • ask us to delete or stop using your data, in the cases the Act provides for;
  • withdraw a consent you gave, for example for the newsletter; and
  • complain to the Data Protection Authority of Sri Lanka if you think we have handled your data wrongly.

To use any of these rights, to stop receiving the newsletter or to withdraw any other consent, write to us through the Contact page with your name, the email address on your order or account and what you would like us to do. When you ask us to stop the newsletter, we remove you from the list. We may ask you to confirm who you are first. If you live outside Sri Lanka, the same rights apply to you.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy. The date it was last changed is shown at the top of this page.
terms:
These terms apply to every order you place on Colombo Wardrobe, the online shop of Spencer Denim Industries Pvt Ltd (in these terms, we and us). By placing an order you agree to them. They work together with our delivery page, our returns page and our privacy policy, linked at the foot of every page.

Placing an order

When you place an order we hold your items while we wait for your payment. Your order is confirmed when your payment has been received.

  • If payment does not arrive by the deadline shown on your order page and in your order email, the order is cancelled automatically and the items go back on sale.
  • You can cancel an unpaid order yourself from your order page.
  • To cancel an order you have already paid for, contact us before we dispatch it. Our returns page explains refunds.

If we cannot supply an item after you have paid for it, we will tell you and refund what you paid for that item.

Prices

Prices are shown in Sri Lankan rupees (LKR) and are the prices on the website when you place your order. We may change prices at any time, but a change does not affect an order you have already placed.

  • The delivery fee is shown at checkout before you pay.
  • Customs duties and import taxes that an overseas delivery attracts are not included in our prices and are your responsibility.

Payment

  • PayPal is available for every order and is the way to pay for a delivery outside Sri Lanka.
  • For a delivery within Sri Lanka we may also offer payment by bank transfer.
  • The payment methods open to you are shown at checkout.

PayPal takes payments in US dollars. When you pay with PayPal we convert your total from rupees to US dollars at an exchange rate that we set, which includes a small allowance for currency movement, and PayPal shows you the amount in US dollars before you approve the payment. Your bank or card issuer may add its own currency conversion charges. We never see or store your card details.

If you pay by bank transfer, follow the instructions on your order page and pay by the deadline shown there. We confirm your order once we have checked your payment.

Delivery

We deliver across Sri Lanka and to customers overseas.

  • Within Sri Lanka, delivery fees and estimated delivery times are on our delivery page and at checkout.
  • For an overseas delivery, the fee, the estimated delivery time and whether we deliver to your country are shown at checkout before you pay.

Delivery times are our best estimate and not a promise, and we are not responsible for delays caused by couriers, customs or events outside our control.

Returns and refunds

You can return or exchange most items within the time set out on our returns page, and we replace or refund anything that arrives damaged, faulty or wrong. That page gives the full rules, including what cannot be returned. Nothing in these terms takes away your legal rights as a consumer.

Your account

  • You do not need an account to buy from us.
  • If you create one, keep your password private and tell us straight away if you think someone else is using your account.
  • You are responsible for what happens under your account until you tell us.
  • We may suspend an account that is used to abuse the shop.

Product information

We take care to describe our products, colours and sizes accurately. Colours can look different on different screens and sizes can vary between styles, so please check the size guide on the product page where there is one.

Reviews

A review is the opinion of the customer who wrote it, and the review form tells you that your first name and the initial of your last name are shown with it. We may remove a review that is offensive, is not about the product or includes personal details.

Our content

The photographs, text, logo and designs on this website belong to us or are used with permission. Please do not copy or reuse them without our written permission.

Our responsibility to you

Nothing in these terms limits any liability that the law does not allow us to limit. Otherwise, as far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss caused by events outside our reasonable control.

Changes and governing law

We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when they were last changed. These terms are governed by the laws of Sri Lanka, and the courts of Sri Lanka have jurisdiction over any dispute about them.

Contact

If you have a question about these terms or about an order, write to us through the Contact page.
